key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:02DC

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:06EC

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:0748

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1B88

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1BDA

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1C6C

description: Allocates a signal bit and a message port structure, releasing whatever it obtained and returning zero if either step fails. Otherwise it fills in the owning task and the port's list, adds the port to the system port list when a name is given, and returns the record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1CFC

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1D44
name: get_valid_stream_slot
description: Checks that an index refers to an open entry in the stream table. If it does not, it records a bad-handle error and returns null; otherwise it returns the address of that entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1D84
name: check_break_signal_and_exit
description: Reads the task's signal state and, if a break signal is set and a break handler is installed, calls the handler. If the handler returns nonzero it clears the handler and exits with an error code.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:22:1DD0

description: Allocates a temporary buffer, reads the open record's mode bits through a helper, and returns zero when the requested combination of read, write and append access matches them, otherwise minus one. It records an error on failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0000
name: read_char_uppercased_guarded

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:000C
name: read_input_until_zero_checked
description: After a stack-space check, calls helper routines in a loop, passing a character each time, until a zero character is returned. It then reads one more character and returns it in uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0052
name: allocate_work_buffers
description: Allocates a 32-byte control block and a 185000-byte work buffer, initialises their header fields and links, and when a memory size threshold is reached allocates a second 58000-byte buffer. It reports failure through a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:01C8
name: free_work_buffers
description: Releases the work buffers allocated at startup: the control block, the large buffer and, if it was allocated, the second buffer, each through the memory-free routine.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0230
name: shutdown_game_state
description: Tears down game state: it clears a flag, restores saved pointers in record fields, releases the object pointers held in global variables through helper calls, and finally calls the teardown routine.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0236
name: initialise_game_resources
description: Sets up the game's resources: it opens or allocates a series of objects through helper calls, calling a failure routine when one is missing, clears two 64-byte tables, and initialises several structures and global pointers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:023C
name: allocate_object_table
description: Allocates a 680-byte table and fills in pointer entries that point into it, creates two helper objects, copies a 16-long template into each, and reports failure through the error routine if an object is missing. Returns sixteen.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0242
name: call_helper_if_stack_ok
description: Calls a helper on a global block when the stack-space check passes, then falls through to the shared error tail that reads a stored value and converts a lowercase letter to uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0248
name: run_character_input_loop
description: Runs a loop that waits for character codes and dispatches them: escape, the letters A to D, L and Q are each handled by helper routines. Between events it updates the display state through helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:024E
name: initialise_display_and_loop
description: Initialises the display and game state: it reads several table entries through helper calls into global variables, sets initial flags and screen parameters, then enters a loop that reads and dispatches input characters.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0254

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:025A
name: store_memory_size_in_kilobytes

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0260

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:13:0266
name: setup_fixed_panel_and_wait

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:0000
name: set_status_byte_by_flag
description: Calls a helper with a fixed value, reads a stored byte through another helper, and sets a global status byte to one of two fixed values depending on whether the flag argument is zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:003A

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:0246

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:0270

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:028C

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:03B6

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:063A

name: compute_signed_remainder_32bit

description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by an unsigned 32-bit divisor using a normalised 16-bit method. It returns a 64-bit result with the quotient in the high half and the remainder in the low half.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A54

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A6C
name: flush_all_stream_buffers
description: Walks the list of stream records and writes out the pending bytes of each writable record that has buffered output, then calls another routine with its argument.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A72
name: leave_nested_display_update
description: Decrements the nesting counter, and when it reaches zero obtains a display object through a helper and, if a flag is set, refreshes it through two further helper calls.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A78
name: flush_pending_slot_entries
description: Goes through four pending entries. For each non-empty one it passes the stored data to two helpers, then clears the entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A84
name: write_length_prefixed_block
description: Selects one of two global buffers by its flag. When the given pointer is non-null, it passes the buffer, the pointer and the length stored four bytes before the pointer to a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1A8A
name: call_helper_then_pick_table
description: Calls a helper with its argument. If the result is nonzero it calls a helper with the address of one global table, otherwise it calls a helper with that table's alternative address.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:8:1AAE
name: multiply_32bit_low
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values held in data registers using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0000
name: measure_trimmed_string_length

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0036
name: blink_marker_until_key
description: Shows a four-frame cycling marker while waiting for a key press, pausing between frames, then clears it. If the key was escape it calls a helper.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:00D6
name: read_key_in_range
description: Waits for a key code between two given bounds, or escape, by repeatedly calling a helper, and returns the accepted key.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0114
name: wait_for_specific_key
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until it returns the given code, then, when the code is odd, calls the helper once more.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0138
name: read_input_char_in_range
description: Reads characters through a helper until one falls between the two bounds, or until return or escape is pressed, and returns the last character read.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:017C
name: call_helper_with_input_buffer
description: When the stack-space check passes, passes a global input buffer to a helper, then falls through to the shared error tail.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0190
name: wait_for_key_with_timeout
description: Polls a helper for a key, pausing between attempts, for a number of attempts equal to twice the argument. It returns as soon as a key is reported or when the attempts run out.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:01BA
name: wait_until_input_available
description: Loops calling a helper until it returns a nonzero value, pausing briefly between polls, and returns that value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:01CC
name: display_number_field
description: Displays a number on the screen. Values above 999 are first converted through a helper, then passed with fixed parameters to a drawing helper, with a second helper call when the value was large.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0224
name: draw_status_panel
description: Draws a fixed status panel. It clears a state flag, copies several state bytes into place, calls helpers that draw regions of fixed sizes, then restores a saved pointer.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:02C4
name: redraw_map_window_tiles
description: Redraws a five-by-five window of map tiles around the current position. For each cell it looks up a tile in a table of 64 by 64 entries, draws it through a helper with its colour, and redraws the highlight on the cell matching the stored position.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:03F8
name: draw_three_status_rows
description: Draws three fixed rows through a helper, each with a colour taken from a stored table at five-byte steps.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0438
name: rebuild_five_object_slots
description: Releases five stored objects, then for each entry in a five-item table whose value is below 25 obtains a new object through a helper and stores it in the slot list. Returns five.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:04E2
name: compare_value_with_limit
description: Calls a helper for a value and returns one if it is greater than a stored 16-bit limit, otherwise zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0524
name: find_state_two_entry

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:05B8
name: replace_stored_object_from_table
description: Releases the currently stored object if there is one. When the index is below seventeen it obtains a new object from a table entry through a helper, stores it and returns it.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:05FA
name: draw_option_menu
description: Draws an option panel. It selects a highlight colour from a table, draws a frame and ten item rows with their labels through helpers, adds further rows depending on a mode flag, and finally removes an interface gadget.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:078A
name: draw_mode_label_text
description: When the mode flag is not one, it formats a stored value into a local buffer, draws one of two text strings chosen by a stored short through helpers, then returns the value.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0818
name: reset_and_redraw_panel
description: Clears a field of the global record, refreshes a label and an icon through helpers, draws a strip of fixed size, and finishes with two helper calls.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:088E
name: draw_main_screen_layout
description: Draws the main screen layout: frames and labels at fixed positions, and either a set of default icons or, when an item slot is active, a row of four and then five slot icons with their names taken from tables.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:0BA8
name: run_cell_redraw_until_key
description: Waits for a key while redrawing eight display cells on each pass, releasing and rebuilding the stored objects and tables first. Each cell is drawn with the colour and state held in its tables.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:106E
name: draw_empty_grid_slots
description: Draws the empty slots of two grids: eight cells in the first row where the matching flag is clear, and seventeen entries reached through an index table. It then calls the final draw helper with the stored colour.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:20:1110
name: draw_highlight_frame_for_item
description: Draws a highlight frame around the item at the given index. It looks up the item's position in two tables and draws an outline and inner lines through helper calls, then finishes with a closing helper.
